newsitem.title: CHINA: Huili to issue no dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Huili to issue no dividend for 1996.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Huili Building Materials Co have approved a plan to offer no returns to investors based on results for 1996, a company statement said on Thursday.

The plan was proposed in late April by the firm's board of directors after the company posted a 67.7 percent fall in net profit to 15.727 milllion yuan in 1996 from 48.695 million yuan for 1995, based on domestic accounting standards.
Based on international accounting standards, 1996 net was only 6.512 million yuan against 48.028 million in 1995.
The company said a changing market which had forced the firm to adjust its product mix depressed its profit.
